## Factory

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| arange | Creates a tile with value starting from 0 to size - 1. Signature: `ct.arange(size, dtype)`. The `dtype` parameter is **required** — omitting it causes a runtime error. Example: `ct.arange(N, dtype=ct.int32)`. |
| full | Creates a tile filled with given value. |
| ones | Creates a tile filled with ones. |
| zeros | Creates a tile filled with zeros. |
